camel_example: aliyun resourcemanager ListAccounts --region cn-hangzhou --IncludeTags true --Tag.1.Key tag_key --PageSize 10 --PageNumber 1 --Tag.1.Value tag_value --method POST --force
description_en: Queries all the members in a resource directory
description_zh: 调用ListAccounts查询整个资源目录下的所有成员列表
kebab_example: aliyun resourcemanager list-accounts --page-number 1 --page-size 10 --tag Value=tag_value Key=tag_key --include-tags true --api-version 2020-03-31 --region cn-hangzhou
name: ListAccounts

parameters.help_en:
The number of the page to return.

Pages start from page 1. Default value: 1
parameters.help_zh:
页码。

起始值：1。默认值：1
parameters.name: page_number

parameters.help_en:
The number of entries to return on each page.

Valid values: 1 to 100. Default value: 10
parameters.help_zh:
分页时每页显示的数据行数。

取值范围：1~100。默认值：10
parameters.name: page_size

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to return the information of tags. Valid values:

false (default value)
true
parameters.help_zh:
是否返回标签信息。取值：
false（默认值）：不返回。
true：返回
parameters.name: include_tags

AccountId.description_en: The Alibaba Cloud account ID of the member

DisplayName.description_en: The display name of the member

JoinMethod.description_en:
The way in which the member joins the resource directory. Valid values:

invited: The member is invited to join the resource directory.
created: The member is directly created in the resource directory
JoinMethod.description_zh:
成员加入方式。取值：

invited：邀请。
created：创建

JoinTime.description_en: The time when the member joined the resource directory. The time is displayed in UTC

ModifyTime.description_en: The time when the member was modified. The time is displayed in UTC

ResourceDirectoryId.description_en: The ID of the resource directory

ResourceDirectoryPath.description_en: The path of the member in the resource directory
ResourceDirectoryPath.description_zh: 成员在资源目录中的路径ID（RDPath）

Status.description_en:
The status of the member. Valid values:

CreateSuccess: The member is created.
PromoteVerifying: The upgrade of the member is being confirmed.
PromoteFailed: The upgrade of the member fails.
PromoteExpired: The upgrade of the member expires.
PromoteCancelled: The upgrade of the member is canceled.
PromoteSuccess: The member is upgraded.
InviteSuccess: The member accepts the invitation
Status.description_zh:
成员加入状态。取值：

CreateSuccess：创建成功。
PromoteVerifying：升级确认中。
PromoteFailed：升级失败。
PromoteExpired：升级过期。
PromoteCancelled：升级取消。
PromoteSuccess：升级成功。
InviteSuccess：邀请成功

Tag.description_en: The tags that are added to the member

items.description_en: The tags that are added to the member

Type.description_en:
The type of the member. Valid values:

CloudAccount: cloud account
ResourceAccount: resource account
Type.description_zh:
成员类型。取值：

CloudAccount：云账号。
ResourceAccount：资源账号

PageNumber.description_en: The page number of the returned page

PageSize.description_en: The number of entries returned per page
PageSize.description_zh: 分页时每页显示的数据行数

TotalCount.description_en: The total number of entries returned
